rulings: Ruling: Reuse the established movie/guide modes and complete the requested queue under the user's existing implementation and deployment authorization — no new design approval is necessary — changes remain subject to behavioral and source verification.

Ruling: Use native Windows bookkeeping instead of the previously stalled Bash helpers — preserves the plan and progress record without repeating a broken helper — manual ledger drift is checked against commits and test output.

Ruling: Keep two Wari observations and the northern Maya writing pattern geographically unplaced — their chronology is supported but a trustworthy observation point is not — users get source-linked evidence without a fabricated pin; finer mapping remains a gap.

Ruling: Move existing records to the new specific guide and link the broader guide to it — preserves one explicit guide home per record and existing page access — the broader page's evidence list becomes smaller.
